thread:
Maya: got a pager on prod-tts — p99 up ~600ms and error rate ~5% (502s). Im starting triage; leaving in ~20m if not stabilized.
incidentbot: ALERT prod-tts error-rate >5% for 10m — top affected routes: /generate, /chat. Pager routed to @Maya (primary).
Jamal: on it as secondary. any mitigation started?
Maya: quick checks: no deploys in last 30m, infra shows elevated CPU and high eviction rate on kvcache nodes. latency spikes line up with cache miss rate.
Priya: i'll ping support to pull impacted customer list. @ops-bot can you post a summary?
ops-bot: Customer impact summary for prod-tts: 12 active customers affected; 3 large customers exceeding 1% error budget — C-2301, C-4412, C-7789.
Maya: following runbook steps now: 1) isolate overloaded kvcache hosts 2) restart kvcache pods rolling 3) enable fallback routing to dedicated model variant. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/tts-kvcache-thrash
Jamal: if we need a quick traffic shift, use the routing control below. also prepare to rollback recent quant-config if behaviour matches that change.
Jamal: ```
# quick routing to dedicated pool for prod-tts
rwctl route update prod-tts --policy=prefer-dedicated --weight=0.2
# rollback recent model-config canary
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/tts-config
# rolling restart of kvcache (one-by-one)
kubectl -n infra delete pod -l app=kvcache --grace-period=30
```
Maya: restarted kvcache pod 1/5, miss rate dropped from 18% -> 9% on that host, overall miss rate down ~6%.
Priya: support confirmed affected customers and I've started incident tickets for each (IDs in support queue). making an initial outbound note for customers.
Priya: creating public incident page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/5512346789
Jamal: i'll take primary in 18 mins (20:30 UTC). Maya, any sticky state I should know about? tokens, temporary ssh?
Maya: nothing sensitive — SSO session open; I left links and exact commands in channel. current mitigations: routing set to prefer-dedicated weight=0.2, restarted 3/5 kvcache pods, rolled back quant-config v2 -> v1. runbook pointer (fallback routing section): https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ops/tts-quick-remediate
incidentbot: NOTE: Maya flagged handoff pending — oncall change will occur at 5512347000 if no further action.
Jamal: i'm assuming primary at 20:30 UTC. quick escalation rules for takeover: escalate to SRE lead @Luca if error_rate >10% or >20% customer impact.
Luca: ack. stand by for deep-dive if fallback routing doesn't reduce errors in 10m.
Maya: handing off now. left a short checklist in the runbook snippet: 
- confirm routing state: `rwctl route show prod-tts`
- kvcache evictions: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/kvcache
- smoke test: `curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tts -d '{"text":"hey"}'`
incidentbot: oncall change recorded: primary -> Jamal, secondary -> Priya.
Jamal: taking primary. i'll monitor p99 and error-rate, will fully enable ded-routing if errors persist past 10m. setting 30min check alarm.
Priya: i'll own customer comms and support queue updates. template posted for incoming messages.
Maya: leaving office now — thanks all. ping if you need me for creds or short context. :thumbsup:
Jamal: quick followup checklist for takeover (added to thread):
1) `rwctl route show prod-tts` -> confirm weight and policy
2) check kvcache evictions and pod restarts in last 15m
3) verify model variant runtime metrics (dedicated vs hosted)
4) if rollback needed: `kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/tts-config`
5) escalate if >10% error-rate or if we hit any customer with >5% impact.
Priya: filing RCA ticket and capturing impact details for support and account teams.
Luca: thanks team. schedule a deep-dive with infra + model tomorrow to root cause the kvcache interaction with quantization config.
Jamal: will update this thread with final status and close when stable. :white_check_mark:
